sourceReceipts.provider: Empresa Brasileira de Correios e Telégrafos
sourceReceipts.edition: DNE schedule current through V.26082, published 2026-08-31
sourceReceipts.finding: Correios calls DNE its official exclusive nationwide database with more than 1.3 million CEPs. Acquisition requires a request, contractual conditions, a term of commitment, payment and licensed use restrictions. The advertised formats are TXT and MDB, not postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon.

sourceReceipts.provider: Empresa Brasileira de Correios e Telégrafos
sourceReceipts.finding: The API is for commercial-contract customers, requires a Brazilian corporate account, service 86738 in the contract and a Bearer token. Documented responses expose address, locality, range and CEP-object attributes but no geometry. No contract, token or endpoint request was attempted.

sourceReceipts.provider: Empresa Brasileira de Correios e Telégrafos
sourceReceipts.finding: The public service is an interactive CAPTCHA-protected query portal. It is not a fixed complete assignment release, a bulk redistribution grant or a geometry artifact and was not scraped or queried.

The sheet confirms eight digits displayed with a hyphen after digit five and distinguishes ordinary delivery, P.O. box, community mailbox and big-mailer examples. It is semantic reference evidence, not a current complete assignment dataset or geometry licence.

blockers: The only identified complete current Correios CEP denominator is the licensed DNE product; it was not acquired because doing so requires commercial coordination, contract acceptance, payment and a use commitment not authorized by this task.
The official Busca CEP API requires a Brazilian corporate account, commercial contract, service 86738 and credentials; no access or rights for AGID redistribution and public serving were established.
The public CAPTCHA query portal is not a reproducible complete fixed release and must not be scraped into one.

No official, derived or virtual rights-cleared nationwide CEP Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact was identified or acquired. Correios address/range responses, DNE TXT/MDB rows, IBGE CNEFE points and CEP aggregates, and census/administrative areas are not postal polygons.

CEP object classes include non-area streets or number ranges, buildings, large users, Correios units, lockers, P.O. boxes, community mailboxes and organizations; they cannot be expanded into invented surfaces.
unblockCondition: Obtain explicit authorization to engage Correios and, if approved, secure a contract or written data licence that permits AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving of a current complete version-pinned DNE assignment denominator. Independently obtain or reproducibly derive a rights-cleared fixed CEP Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact only for area-capable assignments, with typed non-area exclusions, complete coverage reconciliation, topology, CRS, method, confidence and exception validation. Then connect that artifact to the real BR API/app path and pass normalization, no-match, multiple, failure, invalid-geometry, fit, translucent-fill, outline, clear and re-search verification.
retryPolicy: Do not contact Correios, create an account, register a Brazilian company, add service 86738, accept a term or contract, pay, use credentials, query or scrape feature/address/customer/P.O.-box/delivery/property/cadastral/land-right rows, create a repository or public destination, or publish/deploy without explicit approval. Recheck only after the retry date and after the pending-country sweep, or sooner if Correios publishes an open fixed postcode geometry release with compatible rights.
